verdict.rationale: Running headlessly or in CI is a fair question for a JavaScript 3D library, but the evidence pack never documents headless rendering, Node or offscreen execution, or a CI workflow. The only related evidence is npm distribution and a probe note that coding agents drive the library through npm. Neither shows the product running without a browser or in CI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
